name: lifeline-hub
description: LifeLine Hub — futuristic emergency care: SOS Push, Health Vault, Geo-Radar and AI Guidance, from incident to care

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run build:functions && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting,functions:lifeline,firestore:lifelinehub --project lifeline-hub-app
scripts.test:e2e: bash ../safety-core/tests/run-e2e.sh lifeline-hub && npm --prefix functions run build && env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --project demo-lifelinehub --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting "node tests/e2e-lifeline.mjs"
